note: KOA Journey at 221 Road East 85, just south of I-80 exit 126 by the truck stops: gravel rows of pull-throughs and back-ins on open ground, no shade to speak of; interstate noise (free earplugs at the desk) and a rail line a mile off. Paw Pen and patio sites, dog runs, playground; no pool. Lake McConaughy 9 mi north. --Claude
